title: Biometry OOD Explorer
description: Versioned research software and a frozen model artifact for age-conditioned joint-biometry atypicality. The package includes browser-only calculation code, synthetic demonstrations, validation summaries, and deidentified calibration geometry arrays. It does not select an intraocular lens formula or establish postoperative accuracy and is not a medical device.
